question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 2.
solution:
The correct answer is '**enormous**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Enormous** means very large in size or quantity.
 
• It is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank as it fits the context of describing the scale of something.
 
• The word "**enormous**" in the context signifies significant changes.
 
• It's suitable here because the sentence is highlighting the scale and magnitude of the changes that have occurred due to the computerization process over a relatively short period.
 
• The use of "**enormous**" emphasizes the extent and impact of these changes, indicating that they have been vast and far-reaching, transforming various aspects of business, education, and public administration.

 

​Correct Passage:__ *Twenty five years ago, few people realised that computers were about to become part of our daily lives. This short period of time has seen **enormous** changes, in business, education and public administration. Jobs which took weeks to complete in the past are now carried out in minutes. People who spent all day copying and checking calculations are now freed from these (3)_______. tasks. Students have become as familiar with hardware and software as their parents were with pencils and exercise books.*

*Computerisation of public records has enabled government departments to analyse the needs of citizens in detail. Some of us may wonder, (4) ______, life has really improved as a result of these changes. Many jobs disappeared, for example, when intelligent machines took over the work. Employers complain that clerical (5)________ have become dependent on calculators and cannot do simple arithmetic.*
